items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Well Panama is, I think he’s a little ill now.

ctx.x: We got to spend a day, I got to spend a day with Panama Francis, and he sounds like a guy who maybe could have cut that Kansas City gig.
Well Panama is, I think he’s a little ill now.
